error_forbidden: You don't have access to this
error_internal_error: Something went wrong on the server
error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in {retryAfter} s.
error_signup_disabled: Public sign-up is disabled. Ask an admin to create your account.
error_invite_invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired
error_email_taken: A user with that email already exists
error_cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own admin role
error_cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account
error_owner_stays_admin: The instance owner stays an admin
error_owner_not_deletable: The instance owner can't be deleted
error_avatar_too_large: Avatar images can be at most {maxMb} MB
error_cannot_suspend_own_sammelband: You cannot suspend your own Sammelband
error_cannot_delete_own_sammelband: You cannot delete your own Sammelband
error_confirm_name_mismatch: Type the Sammelband's name to confirm
error_quota_exceeded: Storage quota exceeded. Ask your admin for more space.
error_folder_own_parent: A folder cannot be its own parent
error_folder_into_descendant: Cannot move a folder into one of its own sub-folders
error_folder_has_albums: Folder is not empty — move or delete its albums first
error_folder_has_subfolders: Folder is not empty — move or delete its sub-folders first
error_target_not_found: The drop target is no longer here
error_anchor_section_not_found: The neighbouring section no longer exists
error_source_disabled: This photo source isn't switched on here
error_source_account_not_found: This account isn't connected any more
error_source_invalid_url: Enter the address of the server (https://…)
error_source_not_nextcloud: No Nextcloud answers at this address
error_source_unreachable: The server can't be reached right now
error_source_host_not_allowed: This server is on a private or local network, which this Sammelband doesn't connect to. The person running it can allow that with SOURCES_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS.
error_source_auth_failed: The server didn't accept the login. Connect the account again.
error_source_item_not_found: Not found on the server any more
error_source_connect_expired: The login took too long. Start again.
error_photo_not_in_album: Photo not found in this album
error_target_photo_not_found: The neighbouring photo no longer exists
error_file_too_large: Photos can be at most {maxMb} MB
error_image_too_large: Photos can have at most {maxMegapixels} megapixels
error_expiry_in_past: The expiry date must be in the future
error_share_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired
error_user_already_exists: A user with that email already exists
error_two_factor_setup_required: Set up two-factor authentication to continue
error_two_factor_own_first: Nice try! Set up two-factor authentication for yourself first, then you can make everyone else do it. 😉
error_two_factor_still_required: Two-factor authentication is required here, so it can't be turned off
error_two_factor_reset_own: Manage your own two-factor authentication in your profile
error_invalid_code: That code isn't right. Try the current one from your app.
error_invalid_backup_code: That backup code isn't valid. Each one works only once.
error_invalid_two_factor_cookie: The sign-in took too long. Please start again.
error_too_many_attempts_request_new_code: Too many attempts. Please sign in again.
error_totp_not_enabled: Two-factor authentication isn't set up yet.
error_account_temporarily_locked: Too many wrong codes. Your account is locked for a while, please try again later.
error_invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
setup_done: Your Sammelband is ready. Sign in to continue.
setup_description: Use the setup code printed in the server log when it started. You become the owner and first admin.
setup_description_multi: Use the setup code printed in the server log when it started. You become the owner of this instance and can later create Sammelbände for others.
login_description: Accounts are created by an admin or with an invite link.
login_code_description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Sammelband.
login_backup_description: Enter one of your backup codes. Each one works only once.
login_trust_device: Don't ask again on this device for 30 days
login_use_app: Use the code from the app
forgot_description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot_sent: If there's an account for {email}, a link is on its way. It works once, within one hour. No mail? Check the spam folder.
reset_description: You'll be signed out on all devices.
reset_done: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.
notfound_joke3_line: Literally. Not even a blurry thumb.
notfound_joke5_title: This photo is still in the camera.
notfound_joke6_line: Whatever was here, it's white now.
notfound_image_label: An empty polaroid dangling from a strip of tape, looking confused
general_name_description: Shown in the menu, on invite links and to everyone in this Sammelband.
general_timezone_description: Share links with an expiry date stop working at 23:59 of that day in this time zone, for everyone in {sammelband}.
general_two_factor_description: Everyone in {sammelband} has to sign in with a code from an authenticator app. Users who haven't set it up are asked to at their next visit.
general_two_factor_by_instance: The server's owner already requires it for everyone on this server.
general_two_factor_off: Two-factor authentication is no longer required
profile_password_changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
profile_avatar_unsupported: Can't process the image in this browser
profile_avatar_description: Shown in the menu and to others in your Sammelband.
profile_email_password: Current password (needed to change the email)
profile_password_description: Changing it signs you out on all other devices.
profile_language_description: Saved with your account, so it applies on all your devices.
two_factor_intro: After your password, signing in also asks for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or your password manager.
two_factor_on_description: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
two_factor_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
two_factor_qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
two_factor_manual_key: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
two_factor_backup_description: Each code signs you in once when you don't have your phone. Keep them somewhere safe, like your password manager. They're shown only now.
two_factor_new_codes_description: Your old backup codes stop working.
two_factor_disable_description: Signing in then needs only your password.
two_factor_required_by_instance_note: Required for everyone on this server.
two_factor_setup_required_tenant: {sammelband} requires it for every account. It takes a minute.
two_factor_setup_required_instance: This server requires it for every account. It takes a minute.
library_drag_hint: Drag to arrange. Drop onto a folder (or a folder above) to move something into it.
library_empty: Nothing here yet. Create a folder or an album to start.
move_confirm_folder_description: The folder moves with everything inside it. Share links keep working; everyone’s manual order for it here is reset.
move_confirm_album_description: The album leaves this folder. Share links keep working; everyone’s manual order for it here is reset.
folder_delete_description: Only empty folders can be deleted. Move or delete its albums and sub-folders first.
invite_link_description: Send this link to the person you want to invite.
invite_link_validity: It works once and expires on {date}. It is shown only now.
share_description_folder: Anyone with a link can view this folder, its sub-folders and albums without an account. Photos are shown in web size, never as originals.
share_description_album: Anyone with a link can view this album without an account. Photos are shown in web size, never as originals.
share_expiry_hint: Links stop working at the end of the chosen day, 23:59 in {zone}.
public_password_hint: Whoever shared this link can tell you the password.
album_cover_hint: Without a chosen cover the album shows its first image.
album_cover_no_photos: No photos yet. Add some to a gallery first.
album_delete_description: The album, its blocks and all its photos are deleted. This cannot be undone.
section_text_placeholder: Write something. **Bold**, - lists and pasted links work as you type.
section_delete_description: Its text and photos are deleted too.
section_new: New section: start typing or add photos.
upload_partial: {reason} Photos before this one in the selection were saved.
upload_drop_move: Drop to move the photo into this section
upload_drop: Drop photos here or click to choose
photo_delete_description: The file is removed from disk unless another photo uses the same image.
users_password_changed: Password changed. {name} has been signed out everywhere.
users_description: Everyone in {sammelband} can see and edit all folders and albums. Admins also manage users.
users_new_description: Share the password with them yourself.
users_invite_description: They get a link to create their own account and choose their password.
users_delete_description: Their folders, albums and photos stay in the library.
users_two_factor_reset_description: For when they lost their phone and their backup codes. They sign in with their password again and set it up anew where it's required.
storage_description: Photos of {sammelband}. The limit counts originals and PDF exports; duplicates are stored once.
storage_orphans: {missing} image(s) are missing on disk and {unknown} file(s) on disk are unknown to the database.
storage_cache_description: Resized versions are generated on first view and cached. Clearing frees disk space; they are regenerated when needed.
storage_clear_description: Originals are kept. The next page views will be slower while images are resized again.
instance_quota_invalid: Enter a positive number of GB, or leave empty
instance_description: Each Sammelband has its own users, albums and photos. You see names and numbers here, never their content.
instance_new_description: You get an invite link for its first admin, who then invites everyone else.
instance_invite_description: Send this link to the person who will run this Sammelband.
instance_quota_description: Counts original photos. Uploads beyond the limit are refused; nothing is deleted.
instance_two_factor_description: Everyone on this server, in every Sammelband, has to sign in with a code from an authenticator app.
instance_suspend_description: Its users are signed out and can't sign in until you resume it. Nothing is deleted.
instance_delete_description: This permanently deletes its {users} user(s), {albums} album(s) and all photo files. It can't be undone.
invite_account_created: Account created. Sign in to continue.
invite_ask_new: Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
invite_admin_description: You were invited to run a new Sammelband. Choose its name and create your admin account.
invite_user_description: You were invited to this Sammelband. Create your account.
invite_sammelband_hint: You can change it later under Admin settings.
invite_signed_in: You're signed in as {email}. Sign out to create a new account with this link.
upload_drop_or_pick: Drop photos here or click to add
sources_description: Connect your accounts to add photos from them in the album editor.
sources_waiting: Sign in to {source} in the new tab and allow access. This page notices on its own.
sources_app_password_hint: Create an app password in Nextcloud under Settings → Security → Devices & sessions.
admin_sources_description: Let people add photos from other services. Each person connects their own account in their profile; imported photos are stored here like uploads.
admin_nextcloud_url_hint: Optional. People connect to it unless they enter another server; changing it doesn't affect connected accounts.
sources_server_default: Your Sammelband's default. Change it to connect another server.
sources_sign_in_instead: Sign in in the browser instead
error_export_disabled: PDF export isn't switched on in this Sammelband
error_export_not_found: This PDF doesn't exist any more
error_album_empty: This album has nothing to export yet
export_description: A photo book to print or share: the cover photo with the title, the description, every section and a back page.
export_waiting: Waiting for other exports to finish…
export_working: Setting the pages and preparing the photos…
export_close_note: You can close this window: the PDF will be waiting under “Exports” in the album menu.
exports_description: PDFs of this album. They stay until someone deletes them.
export_delete_description: The PDF will be gone for everyone in this Sammelband.
album_delete_exports_one: Its PDF export will be deleted too: {names}
album_delete_exports_other: Its {count} PDF exports will be deleted too: {names}
general_pdf_export_description: Everyone in {sammelband} can export albums as PDF photo books. The files count toward the storage limit.
